title: No personal email addresses or home-folder paths in tracked files
assertion: Every tracked text file is free of personal email addresses and home-folder paths. Allowed: GitHub noreply addresses, reserved example domains, git@ in SSH remotes, emails declared in pyproject.toml's [project] authors and maintainers, emails in SECURITY.md, placeholder home folders (/Users/me, /home/user, C:\Users\you, runner, Shared), any line marked 'swerepo: allow-privacy', and the files or folders under [privacy] allow_paths in .swerepo.toml. A finding names the file, line and kind, never what was found.

origin.text: SWERepo's hygiene rule pack (spec §6.8, ADR-20261124-cd64): seamspec/hygiene-privacy@1.
